Frequently Asked Questions
How does iGraal work?
Sign up for free, start your purchase at iGraal and shop as usual. We share the commission the shop pays us back with you as cashback.
Which shops does iGraal have?
Over 1,500 partner shops across fashion, living, travel, electronics, food and more.
Is iGraal free?
Yes. iGraal is always free — there is no membership fee and no subscription.
How does cashback work?
For every purchase you make through iGraal, the shop pays us a commission. We pass a share of it on to you.
When will you receive your cashback?
Your cashback is recorded shortly after the purchase and released once the shop has confirmed the order.
How safe is cashback?
More than 1,000,000 users collect cashback with iGraal, and over 10,000,000 euros have already been paid out to members.
